Performs one GET round trip, connecting only to an address in pinnedAddresses when present - never performing its own, independent resolution of request.uri()'s host that could silently observe a different address than the one a network policy already authorized for this exact connection attempt.
fetch(HttpFetchRequest, Optional<VerifiedNetworkAddresses>) - Method in class io.webagent4j.crawler.JavaHttpFetcher
Performs one round trip, connecting directly to one of pinnedAddresses when present instead of letting HttpClient resolve the destination host itself - HttpClient has no public hook to pin a connection to a caller-supplied address while still using the hostname for the Host header, TLS SNI, and certificate verification, so a present pinnedAddresses routes the request through PinnedSocketHttpTransport instead.

HTTP_CLIENT_ERROR - Enum constant in enum class io.webagent4j.crawler.api.CrawlFailureType
A terminal 4xx response.
HTTP_FETCH - Enum constant in enum class io.webagent4j.policy.network.NetworkRequestKind
One HTTP round trip performed directly by HttpCrawler - the crawler's own IHttpFetcher, never a browser backend.
HTTP_SERVER_ERROR - Enum constant in enum class io.webagent4j.crawler.api.CrawlFailureType
A 5xx response that exhausted its retry budget (or was not retryable).
HttpCrawlDiagnosticsExample - Class in io.webagent4j.examples
Demonstrates full crawl diagnostics: every CrawlStatistics field, plus each structured CrawlFailure - the crawler's fail-closed contract means an unexpected backend problem always surfaces here, never as a silently missing page.
HttpCrawler - Class in io.webagent4j.crawler
Deterministic, sequential HTTP crawler.
HttpCrawler() - Constructor for class io.webagent4j.crawler.HttpCrawler
Creates a crawler using the real network, jsoup, the default host-scope policy, and a real clock.
HttpCrawler(IHttpFetcher, IHtmlLinkExtractor, ICrawlScopePolicy, IWaitSleeper) - Constructor for class io.webagent4j.crawler.HttpCrawler
Creates a crawler with every collaborator injected except the clock, which defaults to IMonotonicClock.systemClock() - the seam tests use to avoid the network and real sleeping.
HttpCrawler(IHttpFetcher, IHtmlLinkExtractor, ICrawlScopePolicy, IWaitSleeper, IMonotonicClock) - Constructor for class io.webagent4j.crawler.HttpCrawler
Creates a crawler with every collaborator injected, including the clock - the seam a determinism test uses to make CrawledPage.fetchDuration() reproducible.
HttpCrawlRestrictedExample - Class in io.webagent4j.examples
Demonstrates scope restriction: sameHostOnly, a path exclusion pattern, and a maxPages bound - then prints every rejected link alongside the CrawlDecisionType that explains why it was never fetched.
HttpCrawlSimpleExample - Class in io.webagent4j.examples
Demonstrates the simplest HTTP crawl: a bounded, same-host breadth-first crawl with no browser, no JavaScript rendering, and no AI - just HttpCrawler following <a href> links.
HttpFetchRequest - Record Class in io.webagent4j.crawler
Immutable GET request for one IHttpFetcher.fetch(HttpFetchRequest) call - one HTTP round trip, never a redirect-following sequence: the caller (the crawl engine) decides whether and how to follow a redirect target, so it can apply crawl scope to it first.
HttpFetchRequest(URI, Duration, Map<String, String>, long) - Constructor for record class io.webagent4j.crawler.HttpFetchRequest
Validates required fields, validates every header name/value against the canonical HttpHeaderValidation rule, and defensively copies the header map.
HttpFetchResult - Record Class in io.webagent4j.crawler
Immutable result of one successfully-completed HTTP round trip - a response was received and its body fully read within the request's byte limit.
HttpFetchResult(URI, int, Map<String, List<String>>, byte[], String, Duration) - Constructor for record class io.webagent4j.crawler.HttpFetchResult
Validates required fields and defensively copies the header map and body.
HttpHeaderValidation - Class in io.webagent4j.crawler.api.internal
The single, framework-owned definition of what caller-supplied crawler HTTP headers are accepted - applied identically regardless of which internal HTTP transport eventually sends the request (JavaHttpFetcher's java.net.http.HttpClient, or the hand-rolled PinnedSocketHttpTransport).
HttpResponseClassifier - Class in io.webagent4j.crawler.internal
Stateless HTTP status code classification.

I

IAction<R> - Interface in io.webagent4j.action
Explicit command that performs one browser operation.
IActionBackend - Interface in io.webagent4j.action
Backend-neutral primitive operations used exclusively by the action pipeline.
IActionBuilder - Interface in io.webagent4j.action
Entry point for defining one immutable browser command before execution.
IActionContext - Interface in io.webagent4j.action
Runtime state made available to an action without exposing a browser backend.
IActionPlan<R> - Interface in io.webagent4j.action
Immutable, backend-neutral, side-effect-free preview of one action pipeline.
IActionPolicy - Interface in io.webagent4j.action.policy
Authorizes one action before its backend side effect is invoked.
IBrowser - Interface in io.webagent4j.browser
Backend-neutral owner of a browser process and its isolated context.
IBrowserCrawler - Interface in io.webagent4j.browsercrawler
A deterministic, bounded-concurrency crawler that discovers and navigates pages through a real browser, for content an HTTP crawler cannot render (JavaScript-rendered links, client-side navigation, authenticated sessions).
IBrowserProvider - Interface in io.webagent4j.browser
Service-provider contract implemented by optional browser backend modules.
ICrawlDeduplicator - Interface in io.webagent4j.crawler.api
Tracks which normalized URLs have already been discovered during one crawl, so the same URL is never fetched twice.
ICrawler - Interface in io.webagent4j.crawler.api
Backend-neutral crawler contract.
ICrawlFrontier - Interface in io.webagent4j.crawler.internal
Deterministically orders pending CrawlTasks for the crawl loop to process.
ICrawlScopePolicy - Interface in io.webagent4j.crawler.api
Decides whether a candidate URL discovered on one page may enter the crawl frontier: scheme, host/domain, and URL-filter rules.

NestedFrameExample - Class in io.webagent4j.examples
Demonstrates nested frame traversal: an IFrame exposes its own frame() entry point, so a frame declared inside another frame's document is resolved strictly inside that parent's scope - it can never accidentally match a same-named frame belonging to the top-level page or a sibling frame.
NETWORK - Enum constant in enum class io.webagent4j.action.ActionDecisionKind
An INetworkPolicy decision - see io.webagent4j.policy.network.
NETWORK - Enum constant in enum class io.webagent4j.crawler.api.CrawlFailureType
A connection or I/O failure (connection reset, DNS failure, connection refused).
NETWORK_POLICY_DENIED - Enum constant in enum class io.webagent4j.browsercrawler.BrowserCrawlFailureType
A configured network policy denied this URL before navigation - IPage#navigate was never called for it.
NETWORK_POLICY_DENIED - Enum constant in enum class io.webagent4j.crawler.api.CrawlFailureType
A configured network policy evaluated to DENY for this URL (the task's own URL or a redirect hop) - checked, and this failure recorded, strictly before any HTTP request for it was ever sent.
NETWORK_POLICY_EVALUATION_FAILED - Enum constant in enum class io.webagent4j.browsercrawler.BrowserCrawlFailureType
A configured network policy failed to evaluate for this URL - threw, or returned a malformed null decision - before navigation.
NETWORK_POLICY_EVALUATION_FAILED - Enum constant in enum class io.webagent4j.crawler.api.CrawlFailureType
A configured network policy failed to evaluate for this URL - threw, or returned a malformed null decision - before any HTTP request for it was ever sent.
NETWORK_POLICY_VIOLATION - Enum constant in enum class io.webagent4j.browsercrawler.BrowserCrawlFailureType
Navigation genuinely completed, but the final URL the browser landed on - only checkable after the fact, since a browser's own internal redirects cannot be intercepted mid-flight - was denied (or failed to evaluate) by a configured network policy.

NetworkPolicies - Class in io.webagent4j.policy.network

NetworkPolicies.NetworkResolutionFailedException - Exception Class in io.webagent4j.policy.network

REJECT_CANCELLED - Enum constant in enum class io.webagent4j.crawler.api.CrawlDecisionType
The crawl was cancelled before this candidate could be claimed.
REJECT_DEPTH - Enum constant in enum class io.webagent4j.crawler.api.CrawlDecisionType
The candidate's depth would exceed CrawlRequest.maxDepth().
REJECT_DOMAIN - Enum constant in enum class io.webagent4j.crawler.api.CrawlDecisionType
CrawlRequest.includeSubdomains() is set and the candidate's host is neither an allowed host nor one of its true subdomains (a lookalike such as evil-example.com for example.com is rejected, never accepted by a bare endsWith check).
REJECT_DUPLICATE - Enum constant in enum class io.webagent4j.crawler.api.CrawlDecisionType
The candidate's normalized URL was already discovered earlier in this crawl.
REJECT_HOST - Enum constant in enum class io.webagent4j.crawler.api.CrawlDecisionType
CrawlRequest.sameHostOnly() is set and the candidate's host does not match.
REJECT_MAX_PAGES - Enum constant in enum class io.webagent4j.crawler.api.CrawlDecisionType
CrawlRequest.maxPages() unique fetch identities have already been claimed at the moment this link was discovered - a proactive, best-effort check: it can still miss a case where the limit is reached by a redirect hop consumed after this link was already enqueued, in which case the authoritative rejection instead surfaces later as a CrawlFailureType.CRAWL_LIMIT_REACHED CrawlFailure, never a silently dropped fetch.
REJECT_SCHEME - Enum constant in enum class io.webagent4j.crawler.api.CrawlDecisionType
The candidate's scheme is not in CrawlRequest.allowedSchemes().
REJECT_URL_FILTER - Enum constant in enum class io.webagent4j.crawler.api.CrawlDecisionType
The candidate's URL matched CrawlRequest.excludeUrlPatterns(), CrawlRequest.includeUrlPatterns() is non-empty and the candidate matched none of them, or (when at least one such pattern is configured) the candidate URL exceeded the maximum length evaluated against them - a resource bound, not a match outcome, but not worth a distinct type of its own since it is still fundamentally a URL-filter-stage rejection.

requireValidHeaders(Map<String, String>) - Static method in class io.webagent4j.crawler.api.internal.HttpHeaderValidation
